description: Run the 9 PHC post-research audit over a finished document. Extracts every checkable claim, runs nine verification checks (source existence, source fidelity, alias sweep, right-level check, secondary sweep, own-files sweep, deterministic number recomputation, deterministic name/ID letter-check, and an independent adversarial pass), and returns one verdict per claim: Verified, Corrected (with what the record actually says), or Held - unverified (with the unreachable deciding source named). Verdicts rest on peer-reviewed sources and primary records only. Use this AFTER research or drafting is complete, on work a human will sign. It does not slow generation: it is a separate audit step, invoked on finished work.
name: run_9phc_audit

document.description: The full text of the finished document to audit.

title.description: Document title for the report header.

user_files.description: Optional: the user's own prior files/outputs, searched by check 6 for contradictions with the document. When omitted, check 6 does not apply and is skipped.

returns.description: Structured findings: summary counts plus, per claim, the verdict, any correction, any held reason naming the door, per-check outcomes, and receipts (source, class, detail, reference).
